adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler first blocks requests unless `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is truthy. That constant is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is undefined (even if the header is also undefined), the route returns 403 before the `!==` comparison is evaluated. Therefore the stated “both undefined passes and leaves it open” condition is not supported by the diff.
